families.name: 15-min vs hourly pair (arbitrage)
families.idea: The 15-minute market that closes on the hour and the hourly 'above K' ladder settle on the same price. Buying 15-min YES plus hourly NO at a strike at or above the 15-min strike (or the mirror pair) pays at least $1 whatever happens; trade it when the two quotes leave a margin.

families.name: 15-min priced off the hourly ladder
families.idea: Read the market's own probability for the 15-minute strike off the hourly ladder (interpolating between the nearest hourly strikes) and buy the 15-minute side that is cheaper than that.

families.name: Hourly ladder monotonicity
families.idea: Inside one hourly ladder a higher strike can never be more likely than a lower one. When a higher strike's YES bid sits above a lower strike's YES ask, buy YES low + NO high (pays at least $1).

data: crypto 15-min markets closing on the hour + hourly ladders (4 strikes nearest spot), 2026-09-11 to 2026-11-01
